newsitem.title: USA: UTI Energy sets 3-for-1 stock split.
newsitem.headline: UTI Energy sets 3-for-1 stock split.

text.p: UTI Energy Corp said on Tuesday it set a three-for-one stock split.
UTI shares rose two to 62 in morning trading, 3/8 of a point below their year high. The year low was 12-1/2.

The split, if approved August 28 by the company's shareholders, would be effective for shareholders of record as of August 25, and stock certificates for new shares would be mailed on September 5, the company said in a news release.
UTI had 4,036,729 common shares outstanding as of June 30.
Also Tuesday, the company reported second-quarter earnings of $0.38 per share, compared with $0.13 for the same period the year before.
